payload.artist_html: J. Ren, H. Jiang, K. Xiang, C. Sullivan, Y. He, L. Cheng, F. Han
payload.credit_html: "A new basal ichthyosauromorph from the Lower Triassic (Olenekian) of Zhebao, Guangxi Autonomous Region, South China"
payload.description_html: Photograph and outline drawing of Baisesaurus robustus CUGW VH107. The specimen comprises semi-articulated incomplete vertebrae, a limb element, ribs and gastralia. Abbreviations: Dv, dorsal vertebrae; L, limb element; G, gastralia; R, ribs.
